newsitem.title: SHARJAH: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS AND PUT NEW ZEALAND IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS AND PUT NEW ZEALAND IN TO BAT.

text.p: Sri Lanka won the toss and asked New Zealand to bat in the opening match of the Singer Champions' Trophy tournament on Thursday.

Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Asanka Gurusinha, Aravinda de Silva, Hashan Tillekeratne, Upul Chandana, Kumara Dharmasena, Chaminda Vaas, Muttiah Muralitharan, Sanjeeva de Silva.
New Zealand - Lee Germon (captain), Nathan Astle, Craig Spearman, Adam Parore, Stephen Fleming, Chris Cairns, Mark Greatbatch, Chris Harris, Dipak Patel, Simon Doull, Danny Morrison.
